Container.Name: kinora
Container.Overview: Kinora is a lightweight, open-source media server written in Rust. It scans your movies and TV shows, fetches artwork and descriptions from TMDB, and streams to any browser or Android TV with hardware transcoding on Intel, AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, including HDR and Dolby Vision tone mapping.[br][br] Keep the Config path on a pool (SSD), not on the array: the database is SQLite and is slow through /mnt/user. If your pool is not named "cache", change /mnt/cache to your pool's name.[br][br] Intel or AMD GPU: set the GPU device field to /dev/dri.[br] NVIDIA GPU: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, then add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (switch on Advanced View).
Container.Requires: Optional, for NVIDIA hardware transcoding: the Nvidia Driver plugin, plus --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings, artwork cache and themes. Use a pool path (/mnt/cache/... or your pool's name), not /mnt/user: SQLite through the /mnt/user share layer makes the app slow. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your movies and shows (read-only). Add libraries from /media in Admin, Libraries.

Config.Name: Transcode temp
Config.Description: Temporary transcode segments. Use an SSD pool path. /tmp/kinora (RAM) also works if you have plenty of free memory; 4K transcodes can use several GB.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding on Intel Quick Sync or AMD. Enter /dev/dri if you have one; leave empty otherwise (the container will not start if /dev/dri does not exist).

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. Free from themoviedb.org. Can also be set later in Admin, Modules.

Config.Name: NVIDIA visible devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA only (needs the Nvidia Driver plugin and --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters): all, or one GPU UUID from the plugin's settings page.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA only. Keep this at all: HDR and Dolby Vision tone mapping needs the graphics (Vulkan) capability.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Log filter. Use debug when reporting a problem.
